title: EOP-UAP-D001, NASC Inquiry into Bahia, Brazil Incident, November 13, 1963
doc_notes: This is a declassified intelligence report summarizing a radio broadcast regarding a crash in Brazil, and it contains one encounter report.

encounters.summary: A large metal sphere crashed in Conde, Bahia, containing a human-like body in heavy clothing with undecipherable inscriptions.
physical_effects: gouging a hole four meters deep
encounters.quote: A LARGE METAL SPHERE FELL IN THE CENTER OF THE CITY, GOUGING A HOLE FOUR METERS DEEP.
